LanguageData.RHA_029_Intro: Choose a direction, then face its trial. Progress is permanent; deeper path effects require the original path sources.
LanguageData.RHA_029_NeedPawn: Choose a present, standing colonist wearing the selected relic.
LanguageData.RHA_029_UseStar: Continue this route in the star atlas. New trials use the star route.
LanguageData.RHA_029_NeedGrowth: The relic needs its initial awakening progress.
LanguageData.RHA_029_NeedEssence: Not enough trial essence for the first awakening.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Busy: Finish the active trial or ascension challenge first.
LanguageData.RHA_029_NeedBeacon: A player trial beacon on the same home map is required.
LanguageData.RHA_029_OpenArena: The beacon needs enough open, reachable ground nearby.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Started: Ascension trial started. Enemies arrive in 10s. Move the candidate into the blue circle.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Interrupted: Ascension interrupted. Your choice is kept; difficulty is unchanged.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Timeout: Ascension timed out. Your choice is kept; difficulty is unchanged.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Cancelled: Trial cancelled. Your choice is kept; difficulty is unchanged.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Legend: Gold: acquired · Blue: offered · Orange: awaiting trial · Grey: unacquired
LanguageData.RHA_029_Active: Acquired; active while basic sources are present.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Challenge: This node has {0} prior clears. Complete {1} seals. Each success adds pressure, capped at four; failures do not count.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Rule_thunder: From the blue circle, personally hit two different trial enemies, then channel for 2s. Leave a red circle within 3s or lose progress. Allies cannot provide hit credit.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Rule_flame: From the blue circle, deal actual burn damage to trial enemies, then channel for 2s. Leave a red circle within 3s or lose progress.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Rule_guardian: From the blue circle, absorb trial attacks with your shield, then channel for 2s. A temporary trial ward is provided in the circle. Dodge red warnings.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Rule_harvest: Stand still in the blue seedbed until cultivation is complete. Leaving gradually loses progress. Allies may hold off enemies; red warnings must still be avoided.
LanguageData.RHA_029_StartHint: Prepare your candidate and supporting colonists. Enemies spawn near the beacon; failure may cause injury or death.
LanguageData.RHA_029_StageRules: From stage 2, dodge a warning for each seal. From stage 4, enemies inside the blue circle interrupt channeling. Stage 5 requires a 5s channel. Trial reserves: at most 12 waves. Nodes sharing a mechanic add strength up to 2 and share cooldowns.
LanguageData.RHA_029_PawnHint: View this colonist's progression, relics and augments.
LanguageData.RHA_029_Exhausted: Trial reserves exhausted. Your choice is kept; difficulty is unchanged.
